# 01 Lift the style resolver and its gate into a shared module

## Outcome

`resolveStyles` and the validation gate are written once, in a module named for the language rather
than for the class diagram, and `buildClassModel` calls them. Class-diagram behavior is byte-identical.

## Why this ticket exists

Both sit as private functions in `buildClassModel.ts`. The gate is the one ADR-0008 calls "the
board's security boundary for styling" — the only place a value is checked before a renderer emits
it verbatim into an inline `style` attribute. Flowchart cannot use either without copying them, and
board 2 spent four tickets deleting copies made for exactly that reason.

The contract names carry a `Class` prefix for the same historical reason `ClassDirection` did, and
board 1 already settled what to do about that.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `packages/core/src/graph-model/resolveStyles.ts` exports
      `resolveStyles(declarations: readonly StyleDecl[], validTargetIds: ReadonlySet<string>,
      diagnostics: Diagnostic[]): ResolvedStyle[]` — the same shape as `resolveTimeline`, so the
      two read as one pattern.
- [x] The validation gate moves with it: the CSS-identifier check, the `url(`/`expression(`
      rejections, the `;` rejection and the `\` rejection, with their reasoning comments intact.
      The comments are why the gate is safe; a move that drops them loses the argument.
- [→] **Moved to ticket 01b.** `contracts.ts` renames `ClassStyleProperty` → `StyleProperty`, `ClassStyleDeclKind` →
      `StyleDeclKind`, `ClassStyleDecl` → `StyleDecl`, `ResolvedClassStyle` → `ResolvedStyle`, and
      `ResolvedStyle.classId` becomes `targetId`. No `Class`-prefixed style type survives.
- [→] **Moved to ticket 01b.** `StyleDeclKind`'s apply-directive member is **one canonical name**, not `cssClass`. The class
      parser normalizes `cssClass` to it, as `parseDirection` normalizes `TD` to `TB`. Pick the
      name and justify it in your report — `"apply"` is the planner's suggestion, not a requirement.
- [x] `buildClassModel` calls the shared functions; it declares neither `resolveStyles` nor
      `rejectStyleProperty`/`acceptedProperties` any more.
- [x] `resolveStyles.test.ts` covers the rules directly at the new seam: an unknown target id, a
      `classDef` a later apply-directive names, an apply-directive naming a `classDef` that does not
      exist, last-property-wins ordering, and one case per rejection in the gate.
- [x] Every existing assertion in `buildClassModel.test.ts` passes **unedited**. This is a
      behavior-preserving extraction, so a test that needs changing is a bug in the extraction.
      That file is deliberately NOT in your write scope.
- [x] Do **not** implement the `color` routing split. Ticket 06 owns it. `ResolvedStyle` keeps one
      flat property list for now.

## Test seam

`resolveStyles` directly, plus `buildClassModel.test.ts` as the regression net.

## Write ownership

- `packages/core/src/graph-model/resolveStyles.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/graph-model/resolveStyles.test.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/graph-model/buildClassModel.ts`
- `packages/core/src/contracts.ts`
- `packages/core/src/parser/parseClassDiagram.ts` (only for the `cssClass` normalization)
- `packages/core/src/renderer/renderClassDiagramToSVG.ts` (only to follow the type renames)

## Shared resources

`contracts.ts` — ticket 02 does not touch it, so within this round it is yours alone.

## Blocked by

Nothing.

## Status

Done in part (2026-09-05), commit 6c2947c. 3 slices. 513 core tests / 29 board, tsc clean both.

**This ticket was over-scoped by the planner and its two halves contradicted each other.** It
demanded the `classId` → `targetId` rename *and* that `buildClassModel.test.ts` pass unedited while
staying outside the write scope — but that suite hand-builds `styleKind: "cssClass"` fixtures and
asserts on `classId` in 52 places. The worker proved the contradiction in a throwaway copy rather
than by breaking the shared tree, and reported it instead of quietly editing the regression net.

The extraction half landed and is self-contained. The renames are ticket 01b, which also picks up
`layoutClassDiagram.ts` — it reads `style.classId` and appeared in no ticket's ownership list.

## Done when

Every criterion is checked, `pnpm -r test` is green, and `tsc --noEmit` is clean in both packages.
